material_status: All active problem rewards are symbolic. There are no pledged, funded or awarded material rewards.

rewards.label: A Coffee
rewards.description: A coffee or equivalent gesture if separately sponsored.

rewards.label: A Book
rewards.description: A mathematics book of the recipient's choice if separately sponsored.

rewards.label: A Dinner
rewards.description: A meal or equivalent gift if separately sponsored.

rewards.label: A Research Prize

statuses.label: Symbolic
statuses.meaning: Designation only; no item or payment is promised.

statuses.label: Pledged
statuses.meaning: A named sponsor has documented an explicit commitment and terms; funds are not asserted to be secured.

statuses.label: Funded
statuses.meaning: Funds or goods are independently confirmed as secured under public written award terms.

statuses.label: Awarded
statuses.meaning: A verified resolution, named recipient and documented award are linked.
